svg.title: Thabit Mahmood
svg.desc: Title block. Thabit Mahmood. Post-quantum cryptography for verifiable federated learning. PhD Candidate, Multimedia University. Graduate Research Assistant, TM R&D. Abstract: I study how to keep federated learning trustworthy once quantum computers arrive. In federated learning many parties train one model without pooling their data. My PhD at Multimedia University asks how every participant can check that the shared model was computed honestly, and how to keep that guarantee against an adversary with a quantum computer.

Post-quantum cryptography for verifiable federated learning
